title: A chain of three steps
description: A lender's payout desk pays out a loan in three steps: check the payee, pay, reconcile. Five tokens and one unit of money. Every step names the payout it works on. This case is one look at one payout; the recorded sequence reader_one_way shows the next two payouts run and pay all three steps again. The desk's second goal, the yes to a new way of paying out, waits for a row read from the record.
